content_of_post_to_comment: My builder wants to charge me $5,000 extra to switch the windows to black. And there aren’t even that many windows So naturally, my current plan is to get the free white ones and paint them black later. Someone please tell me this is doable and not a terrible idea.
comment: The interesting part is that the $5,000 premium is buying factory finish, not just color. Painting later may work, but the real question is whether the cost difference is worth the future maintenance and warranty tradeoff.
